verdict.rationale: Gide's IP practice group page lists patents among its focus areas and touts litigation strength, UPC advocacy, and trademark expertise, but the evidence explicitly shows Gide handles patent prosecution/drafting via a 30-year partnership with outside patent attorneys (Regimbeau) rather than in-house drafting and filing, and no named patent prosecution practitioners or portfolio-strategy specifics are shown. Missing for 10: named IP/patent practitioners, direct evidence of in-house drafting/filing of applications, and portfolio-strategy case studies rather than litigation/dispute focus.
